UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores additional, application-specific user information beyond authentication details handled by an external system like Firebase Auth.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity, matching the external authentication system's user ID (e.g., Firebase UID).

email.description: The user's email address, often used for display purposes and unique identification within the application.

displayName.description: The user's preferred display name, used for personalization in the UI.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated.

Outbreak.title: Outbreak
Outbreak.description: Represents a specific disease outbreak cluster identified globally, used for heatmap visualization and reporting.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Outbreak entity.

diseaseName.description: The common name of the disease associated with this outbreak (e.g., 'COVID-19', 'Ebola').

latitude.description: The geographical latitude coordinate of the outbreak's primary location.

longitude.description: The geographical longitude coordinate of the outbreak's primary location.

countryCode.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where the outbreak is primarily located.

intensityLevel.description: A numerical value representing the intensity or severity of the outbreak.

status.description: The current status of the outbreak (e.g., 'Active', 'Contained', 'Resolved').

priority.description: The priority level of the outbreak: High, Medium, or Low.

symptoms.description: A list of symptoms reported for this outbreak.

description.description: Detailed clinical description of the reported outbreak.

reportedDate.description: The date and time when the outbreak was reported.

definition.description: Contains global disease outbreak data. Accessible to all authenticated users for reading and reporting.

params.name: outbreakId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific disease outbreak.
